enum.description: array of attribute values if they are static values (currently, only string type is supported).

name_override.description: this field can be used to override the actual attribute name defined by the key. It should be used if multiple metrics have different attributes with the same name.

requirement_level.description: Optional: indicates requirement level of the attribute.

$comment.description: Additional comments for developers (not included in JSON output).

$defs.description: Reusable schema definitions that can be referenced via $ref.

properties.description: Map of configuration properties that define the component's configuration fields.

required.description: List of required property names. Properties in this list must be present in the config.

type.description: The type of the configuration object. Typically "object" for component configs.

attributes.description: array of attributes that were defined in the attributes section that are emitted by this event.

enabled.description: whether the event is collected by default.

entity.description: the entity type this event is associated with.

warnings.description: warnings that will be shown to user under specified conditions.

description.description: Required: description of the feature gate.

from_version.description: Required: version when the feature gate was introduced.

id.description: Required: unique identifier for the feature gate.

reference_url.description: Required: URL with contextual information about the feature gate.

stage.description: Required: lifecycle stage of the feature gate.

to_version.description: Required for stable/deprecated gates: version when the feature gate reached stable stage.

input_type.description: Indicates the type the metric needs to be parsed from. If set, the generated functions will parse the value from string to value_type.

value_type.description: type of number data point values.

setup.description: upports configuring a setup function that runs before goleak checks

skip.description: set to true if goleak tests should be skipped

teardown.description: supports configuring a teardown function that runs before goleak checks

any.description: array of strings representing functions that should be ignore via IgnoreAnyFunction

top.description: array of strings representing functions that should be ignore via IgnoreTopFunction

attributes.description: map of attribute definitions with the key being the attribute name and value being described below.

config.description: JSON Schema based definition for the component's configuration structure

deprecated_type.description: Optional: A deprecated type that is still available as an alias.

description.description: Optional: Brief description of the component.

display_name.description: Optional: Human-readable display name for the component.

events.description: map of event names with the key being the event name and value being described below.

feature_gates.description: Optional: list of feature gate definitions.

generated_package_name.description: Optional: The name of the package that mdatagen generates.

metrics.description: map of metric names with the key being the metric name and valuem being described below.

parent.description: Required for subcomponents: The type of the parent component.

reaggregation_enabled.description: Optional: Enables per-metric reaggregation config generation for metrics with attributes.

resource_attributes.description: map of resource attribute definitions with the key being the attribute name.

scope_name.description: Optional: Scope name for the telemetry generated by the component.

sem_conv_version.description: OTel Semantic Conventions version that will be associated with the scraped metrics. This attribute should be set for metrics compliant with OTel Semantic Conventions.

status.description: Required for components (Optional for subcomponents): A high-level view of the development status and use of this component

telemetry.description: map of metric names with the key being the metric name and valuem being described below.

tests.description: Lifecycle tests generated for this component.

type.description: The type of the component - Usually the name. The type and class combined uniquely identify the component (eg. receiver/otlp) or subcomponent (eg. receiver/hostmetricsreceiver/cpu)

attributes.description: array of attributes that were defined in the attributes section that are emitted by this metric.

deprecated.description: Deprecation information for the metric. Required when stability is deprecated.

enabled.description: whether the metric is collected by default.

entity.description: the entity type this metric is associated with.

semantic_convention.description: Optional: the reference to a semantic convention.

stability.description: Optional: the stability level of the metric.

unit.description: metric unit as defined by https://ucum.org/ucum.html.

warnings.description: warnings that will be shown to user under specified conditions.

since.description: Required: version when the metric was deprecated.

allOf.description: All of these schemas must be satisfied (schema composition).

deprecated.description: Indicates if this property is deprecated.

exclusiveMaximum.description: For number/integer types - exclusive maximum value.

exclusiveMinimum.description: For number/integer types - exclusive minimum value.

items.description: For array types - schema for array items.

maxItems.description: For array types - maximum number of items

maxProperties.description: For object types - maximum number of properties allowed.

minItems.description: For array types - minimum number of items

minProperties.description: For object types - minimum number of properties required.

multipleOf.description: For number types - value must be a multiple of this number.

pattern.description: For string types - regular expression pattern that the value must match.

properties.description: For object types - properties of the nested object.

type.description: The JSON Schema type of this property.

uniqueItems.description: For array types - whether all items must be unique.

enabled.description: whether the resource attribute is added the emitted metrics by default.

enum.description: array of attribute values if they are static values (currently, only string type is supported).

warnings.description: warnings that will be shown to user under specified conditions.

class.description: The class of the component (For example receiver)

codeowners.description: Metadata related to codeowners of the component

deprecation.description: The deprecation information for deprecated components.

distributions.description: The distributions that this component is bundled with (For example core or contrib). See statusdata.go for a list of common distros.

stability.description: The stability of the component - See https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector#stability-levels

warnings.description: A list of warnings that should be brought to the attention of users looking to use this component

aggregation_temporality.description: whether reported values incorporate previous measurements (cumulative) or not (delta).

monotonic.description: whether the metric is monotonic (no negative delta values).

config.description: {} by default, specific testing configuration for lifecycle tests.

expect_consumer_error.description: Whether it's expected that the Consume[Logs|Metrics|Traces] method will return an error with the given configuration.

goleak.description: {} by default generates a package_test to enable check for leaks

skip_lifecycle.description: false by default Skip lifecycle tests for this component. Not recommended for components that are not in development.

skip_shutdown.description: false by default Skip shutdown tests for this component. Not recommended for components that are not in development.
